Flag artwork: flag-icons 7.6.0 by Panayiotis Lipiridis, MIT. https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons

Bundled two-letter flag codes were rasterised from the package 4x3 SVG collection to 96x72 PNGs and embedded in src/race-flags.js. No flag service is contacted at runtime. The original license is included here. Rebuild with tools/build-race-flags.py.
